title: Over the Dune | 4BR Vacation Rental on 30A | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Over the Dune is a 4BR Gulf view home in Blue Mountain Beach on 30A with a private saltwater pool and steps to beach access. Sleeps 12. Reserve with Royal Destinations!
description_expanded: Description: Over the Dune by Royal Destinations Location: Blue Mountain Beach Address: 19 Draper Lane Details: Experience the perfect blend of luxury and laid-back beach living at Over The Dune, a stunning home in the private, gated community of Old Florida Beach. Enjoy breathtaking Gulf views, a private pool, and easy beach access just steps away. This beautifully designed retreat features 4+ bedrooms, 5.5 baths, and elegant coastal décor throughout. Highlights include Bosch appliances, four balconies with Gulf views, and spacious living areas that are ideal for entertaining or relaxing with family and friends. The poolside patio offers a grill, lounge chairs, and space to gather and make lasting memories. Guests also enjoy access to community amenities including a heated pool, pool house, three beach walkovers, and a dock on Draper Lake. Nestled near Blue Mountain Beach, one of the world’s few coastal dune lake destinations, Over The Dune is perfectly positioned for biking, paddling, or exploring all that 30A has to offer. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: 2-Minute Walk -Parking Spaces: 3 -Dining Accommodations: 10 at the Table, 4 at the Bar -Regular Coffee Maker and Keurig Available -Gulf Views -Private Saltwater Pool -Bosch Appliances -Gas Grill -Community Pool -Gated Community -Across from Beach Access Sleeping Arrangements (sleeps 12): First Floor: -Suite 1: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower and Soaking Tub) and a Flat Screen TV -Laundry room Second Floor: -Suite 2: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower), a Balcony, and a Flat Screen TV -Suite 3: Queen Bed with Private Bath (Shower), and a Flat Screen TV -Bunk Room: Twin Bed and a Twin over Twin Bunk with a Detached Dual Vanity Bath, and a Flat Screen TV -Sitting Area: Bonus Built-in Twin Bed with Shared Bath Third Floor: -Queen Sleeper Sofa -Full Bath with Shower -Large Balcony -Kitchenette/Wet Bar -Large Flat Screen TV Amenities Include: -4 Adult Bikes -1 Beach Service Set* *Seasonal: March – October Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
